Name: NPC Pathable Backwoods
Author: zombifier
Description:
[b][size=4]For Users:[/size][/b]
This mod does one user-visible thing on its own - enabling the stairs in the Backwoods without needing to purchase the community shortcuts from Robin. It otherwise should have no impact to (vanilla) NPC pathing.

[b][size=4]For Mod Makers:[/size][/b]
This mod allows NPCs to path to and through the backwoods, which was disallowed in the vanilla game because without the shortcut stairs it consists of two disjointed sections, which breaks the game's pathfinder (it cannot tell that an NPC entering from the mountains can't reach the bus stop). By enabling the shortcut stairs unconditionally and connecting the two sections, and alongside removing the hardcoded NPC pathfinding ban in the game code, this allows NPCs to freely walk through them without issue.

If your character has been looking for space and is finding the Pelican Town real estate situation somewhat dire, this mod allows them to possibly make use of the (admittedly still small) backwoods space as their own.

To install, install SMAPI and extract this mod into the Mods folder as usual.

Source: [url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/PathableBackwoods]https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/PathableBackwoods[/url]
